FROMGIT: ath10k: add peer id check in ath10k_peer_find_by_id For some SDIO chip, the peer id is 65535 for MPDU with error status, then test_bit will trigger buffer overflow for peer's memory, if kasan enabled, it will report error. Add check for overflow the size of peer's peer_ids will avoid the buffer overflow access. Call trace of kasan: dump_backtrace+0x0/0x2ec show_stack+0x20/0x2c __dump_stack+0x20/0x28 dump_stack+0xc8/0xec print_address_description+0x74/0x240 kasan_report+0x250/0x26c __asan_report_load8_noabort+0x20/0x2c ath10k_peer_find_by_id+0x180/0x1e4 [ath10k_core] ath10k_htt_t2h_msg_handler+0x100c/0x2fd4 [ath10k_core] ath10k_htt_htc_t2h_msg_handler+0x20/0x34 [ath10k_core] ath10k_sdio_irq_handler+0xcc8/0x1678 [ath10k_sdio] process_sdio_pending_irqs+0xec/0x370 sdio_run_irqs+0x68/0xe4 sdio_irq_work+0x1c/0x28 process_one_work+0x3d8/0x8b0 worker_thread+0x508/0x7cc kthread+0x24c/0x264 ret_from_fork+0x10/0x18 Tested with QCA6174 SDIO with firmware WLAN.RMH.4.4.1-00007-QCARMSWP-1. Signed-off-by: Wen Gong <wgong@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Kalle Valo <kvalo@codeaurora.org> (cherry picked from commit 49ed34b835e231aa941257394716bc689bc98d9f git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git ath-next) BUG=b:127602122 TEST=test with kasan enable success Change-Id: I9174a0cc7018113530dd458c31b7c0340236b48d Signed-off-by: Wen Gong <wgong@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Claire Chang <tientzu@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1565606 Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>

FROMGIT: ath10k: change swap mail box config for UTF mode of SDIO For SDIO chip, it does not have HTT connect step in boot phase of UTF mode, so it does not need the swap configuration for UTF mode, otherwise it will trigger UTF load fail. For normal mode, it is swap between HTT and WMI, for UTF mode, it does not have HTT, so it can not swap between HTT and WMI. Disable swap mail box for UTF mode will let UTF mode load success. Tested with QCA6174 SDIO with firmware WLAN.RMH.4.4.1-00007-QCARMSWP-1. Signed-off-by: Wen Gong <wgong@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Kalle Valo <kvalo@codeaurora.org> (cherry picked from commit 8cdee1affe9000df55558fb1cd407b510f7406a6 git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git ath-next) BUG=b:124327202 TEST=Test ftm mode load success Change-Id: Icd6e487b899ec1da8c57d022565ea44f0eba40d2 Signed-off-by: Wen Gong <wgong@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Claire Chang <tientzu@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1565605 Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>

CRAS: server_metrics - Log missed callback schedules after rescheduling We already have two UMA logs MissingCallbackFrequency and MissingCallbackFirstTime to check the frequency of missing callback events. However, we don't know whether it becomes better after rescheduling. So we add two more logs to check it. 1. MissingCallbackFrequencyAfterReschedulingInput/Output The number of missed callbacks in a day after rescheduling. It is calculated by number of the missed callbacks / runtime of the stream after rescheduling. 2. MissingCallbackSecondTimeInput/Output When the second time audio thread misses callback schedule, record how many seconds have passed since the first time. BUG=chromium:918462 TEST=These UMA logs can be recorded well on peppy. Change-Id: Ie1f137eb1313b87da293b34f1cb18a13d41653d8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1592896 Commit-Ready: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yu-Hsuan Hsu <yuhsuan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: mesh: path selection stability enhancement Apply a more strict rule for next-hop update to increase stability. This change aligns the path selection policy with that of Gale. The following rules are added: 1. Always update if the next-hop stays the same. 2. The 10%-better rule is applied not only within the same SN, but also newer SN. BUG=b:129904653 TEST=manually test on 3 mistral and mistral + vento + gale Change-Id: I11a05fda4899b60d8266e361308eec9ad971e243 Signed-off-by: Roy Luo <royluo@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1598849 Reviewed-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com>
